local_implementation_authorization.source: Current thread: codeit now pleas, following presentation of implementation plan 0.2
local_implementation_authorization.scope: Local distance-first pilot, existing card, <=900-second walking cutoff, bounded route requests and separately labeled farther supplements. Not live-provider access, production activation or release admission.

approval_scope: Owner requested correction of the implementation plan: implement and validate distance first, recommendation correction second, V8 release checks last. Existing-card visual intent, <=15-minute Walkable intent and at-least-five preference are confirmed. Proposed execution defaults are not owner-approved provider/privacy/budget activation, count/radius fallback or exact matching rules.
admission: Not the frozen V8 release ledger. No frozen PRD/ledger digests changed. Freeze and pin this delta only after its decisions are resolved; the existing check:contract does not admit this draft.

proposed_defaults.provider_candidate: hosted openrouteservice; verify current terms and both modes before external calls
proposed_defaults.insufficient_walkable_presentation: automatic separately labeled A little farther away supplement
proposed_defaults.local_verification: intercept provider responses in existing test tools; never runtime mock ETAs
proposed_defaults.activation_boundary: Local fixture-based implementation after behavior approval is separate from live provider access, coordinate disclosure, spending authorization and real-route acceptance.

requirements.behavior: Existing ResultCard retains layout and walking line; smaller driving time/distance line underneath, readable on both supported phone layouts.
One labeled origin and destination per search; route modes are distinct; Maps uses the same inputs; coarse/stale origins cannot claim precise from-you estimates.
Walkable classification requires a current walking-route duration <=900 seconds before rounding, never an expanded radius or fixed straight-line multiplier.
At least five options when available, without presenting longer trips as Walkable; exact farther-result presentation must be resolved explicitly.
Bounded route work and permitted reuse; privacy, validation, rate limits, outage fallback and secondary-surface consistency are verified before activation.
After distance validation, evaluate nearer relevant recommendations and driving/Anywhere semantics without unapproved taste retuning.

shared_contract.actor: Signed-in or signed-out Next Bar user choosing a destination; owner controls provider and rollout decisions.
shared_contract.entry_point: Next Bar results; audit travel labels and directions in Map, Friends and BarLightbox.
shared_contract.audience: The searching user only; no origin included in public sharing or social posts.
shared_contract.data_owner: User owns their location input; routing provider and its permitted retention remain a decision.
shared_contract.trust_boundary: Browser to approved routing service/backend; no new transmission until approved; validated bounded inputs and server-side secrets.
shared_contract.retention: No persistent location history or exact-coordinate telemetry; provider-permitted session reuse only after policy selection.
shared_contract.failure_recovery: Honest unavailable/limited state and directions fallback; no fabricated five results or straight-line minute fallback.
shared_contract.accessibility: Readable smaller line, labeled modes, enlarged text, keyboard actions, both existing phone viewports; no wheelchair-accessibility promise.
shared_contract.evidence: Current code inspection only; no distance implementation or route validation claimed. Candidate evidence must be supplied after implementation.
